answers.note: Плечевой и тазобедренный суставы позволяют конечности двигаться в нескольких направлениях и вращаться.

Сокращение мышечных волокон создаёт натяжение, которое передаётся сухожилиям для движения скелета.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: D1 resolved: prompt specifies the freely movable connection with bone surfaces contacting within a fluid-filled cavity, matching synovial joints at 9.1 L35 and L38, not the umbrella joint/articulation category at L30. «Сустав» is now a coherent Russian answer without including skull sutures or all cartilage connections. Tendon (muscle-to-bone band), muscle (contractile structure) and cartilage (material in a connection) do not name that cavity-bearing whole connection. Short parallel nominative musculoskeletal labels provide plausible confusions without grammar/format clue.

absoluteLevel.assessment: The required answer is the broad adult school/body term сустав, identified through free bone movement. The cavity description adds precision without requiring the technical word синовиальный or a classification recall; the four labels remain familiar same-system alternatives. A nonexpert can plausibly confuse connective tissue/cartilage/muscle with the joint, so the answer is not obtained from absurd options. The additional shoulder/hip movement fact is in the note, not required to solve the question. EASY is retained on the actual revised wording.
